definition: Biological applications of bifurcation theory study how a change in a model parameter can cause a qualitative shift in the modeled behavior of a biological system.
entry_text: Biological applications of bifurcation theory study how a change in a model parameter can cause a qualitative shift in the modeled behavior of a biological system.
example: An ecologist models how an increase in nutrient input might shift a lake from one persistent ecosystem state to another.
label: Biological applications of bifurcation theory
